name: GetFilePathPartsNode
label: Get File Path Components
description: Extracts various parts (directory, name, extension) from the given file path.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: FilePath
fields.label: Source File Path
fields.description: The full path of the file from which to extract components.

fields.name: RootPath
fields.label: Root Path
fields.description: The root path of the source file.

fields.name: Directory
fields.label: Directory Path
fields.description: The directory of the source file.

fields.name: FileName
fields.label: File Name
fields.description: The name of the source file.

fields.name: FileNameNoExtension
fields.label: File Name Without Extension
fields.description: The file name (without the extension) of the source file.

fields.name: FileExtension
fields.label: File Extension
fields.description: The extension (for example, .doc) of the source file.

fields.name: CreationDateTime
fields.label: Creation Date Time
fields.description: The creation date and time of the source file.
